observations: 4 photos show a multifunction photocopier/printer with the top scanner lid open in 3 of them, exposing the glass platen and a document feeder cover.
Control panel in photo 2 reads 'SHARP' and appears to show 'AR-M201' near the display, with a small LCD, numeric keypad, and function buttons (COPY/SCAN/FAX icons).
Top cover/feeder tray in photo 2 shows visible staining, dust and grime on the white plastic.
No photo shows the unit powered on with an active display, a test print/copy output, a power cable, or the rear/side panels.
No visible drawers fully extended to show paper trays, toner cartridge, or drum unit condition.
Lighting is poor/dark in photos 1-3, making wear and panel legibility hard to fully confirm.

claims.evidence: Brand and model text visible on control panel in photo 2
Surface dirt/staining visible in photo 2, but overall usage history and internal wear cannot be judged from photos
No photo shows the unit powered on, a live display, or a sample print/copy output

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have electrical faults
risks.proof: A video or photo of the unit powered on with the display lit and a status/ready screen visible

risks.risk: Print/copy/scan engine may not produce usable output (common failure point: fuser, drum, rollers)
risks.proof: A photo of an actual test print or copy output from the machine

risks.risk: Toner/drum may be empty, expired, or non-OEM and near end of life
risks.proof: Photo of open toner/drum compartment showing cartridge level/brand and condition

risks.risk: Paper feed/document feeder may be jammed or damaged, feeder tray shows visible grime suggesting heavy use
risks.proof: Photo/video of paper trays pulled out and feeder cycling a sheet

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, toner, manual) affecting usability on delivery
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on, showing the display and a completed test copy/print coming out of the tray
Photo of the open toner/drum compartment showing cartridge brand/fill level
Photo of paper trays extended, showing paper path and rollers
Close-up photo of the rating label/serial plate for condition and age verification
response.reason: Brand and model are legible on the control panel, confirming identity, but no photo demonstrates the machine powered on or producing output, so functionality is unverified and must be priced at worst case (non-working) until proof is given.
